title: Coinbase July 2026 Form 8-K
excerpt: Coinbase disclosed that Chief People Officer Lawrence Brock intended to step down effective August 17, 2026 and that Dominique Baillet was expected to be appointed; the filing did not update operating or financial results.
summary: The latest SEC filing available through July 27, 2026 concerns a management transition and does not supersede the Q1 2026 Form 10-Q as the latest quarterly operating and financial evidence.
